\begin{example} \end{example}[The General Linear Group]

1. ch1:1.27The group $\operatorname {GL}(n,\mathbb R)$ is the nonvanishing locus of the continuous determinant on the $n^2$-dimensional vector space of real $n\times n$ matrices. It is therefore an open smooth submanifold of dimension $n^2$. \end{example}
